description: Print value of a symbolic link or canonical file name

option.name: --canonicalize
tip: canonicalize by following every symlink in every component of the given name recursively; all but the last component must exist

option.name: --canonicalize-existing
tip: canonicalize by following every symlink in every component of the given name recursively, all components must exist

option.name: --canonicalize-missing
tip: canonicalize by following every symlink in every component of the given name recursively, without requirements on components existence

option.name: --no-newline
tip: do not output the trailing delimiter

option.name: --silent
tip: suppress most error messages (on by default)

option.name: --zero
tip: end each output line with NUL, not newline
